messages:
mira: heads-up: support flagged that our 'rate-limit troubleshooting' code snippets break when pasted into apps (users hit 429s). opening a tiny coord thread.
ashok: can you paste the failing response?
mira: from customer logs:
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 6
{"error":"rate_limited"}

tori: common culprits: old SDK param names and naive fixed sleeps. example still shows `maxRetries` (sdk now prefers `retryCount`).
leo: plan: small docs PR to add a migration table (old -> new), swap fixed sleep for compact backoff+jitter helper, and add a one-line checklist: "If you see 429s: 1) verify SDK param names, 2) honor Retry-After, 3) use exponential backoff with jitter, 4) for streams: handle partial payloads/aborts."
mira: include stream triage grep pattern: `stream aborted: requestTimeout=\\d+ms` so support can search logs.
ashok: also add a short line linking to SDK changelog and a one-line changelog blurb so SDK release notes can point back.
tori: i'll open the PR with minimal edits (migration rows + helper + checklist + redirects entry) and ping here.
docs-bot: docs-ci: PR 8201 opened by tori - staging build started.
docs-bot: docs-ci: PR 8201 build succeeded - links validated.
leo: will review and merge after redirect entry is added. thanks everyone.
